properties.notes: This tree was the inspiration for the name of the historic Lone Fir Cemetery, it is located in the northwest section of the lot, roughly opposite 437 SE 22nd Ave.
This tree is located along the fitness trail paralelling NE Halsey St, close to the intersection of NE Halsey and NE 146th Ave.
This tree is the largest Douglas-fir in Portland and can be found 100 yards from the stone house on the Lower Macleay spur trail along Balch Creek.
This tree is found at the southeast corner of this lot, near Buena Vista Dr.
This tree is located along the Cedar Grove Trail in Powell Butte Nature Park.
